{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast]]

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*3 drops [[Cookbook:Tabasco Sauce|Tabasco sauce]]
*[[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]] strips (very thin and lean)
*Very fine [[Cookbook:cracker|cracker]] crumbs or dust
*[[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]

== Procedure ==
#Beat the egg with the Tabasco sauce.
#Dip bacon in the egg mixture, and roll in cracker dust.
#Add butter to a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] over medium heat. When pan is well heated, add the bacon. [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] until golden brown.
#Flip bacon over, cook the other side, and serve on a napkin.

== References ==
''Adapted from '''Grand Union Cookbook''', compiled by Margaret Compton (Grand Union Tea Co., 1902).''
